prompt: Start from the still. The screens move on their own and very fast: the columns of figures scroll in rapid bursts, charts redraw, windows open and close faster than a person could click, a mouse cursor flicks across one screen in jerky darts. On one desk a keyboard sits untouched while its screen keeps working. The coloured light from the screens flickers across the empty chairs and the paper cup. Nobody enters. The camera tracks slowly along the row at desk height, past the empty chairs. Sound: the hum of the computers, the air conditioning, a soft repeated electronic chime from one terminal. No speech, no music. Thanks.
